title: Quietly Smoky Turkish Beef Doner Kebab
description: A cultured and flavorful Turkish dish featuring unsalted beef stock and bhuna, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and can be adapted to be vegetarian-friendly by substituting the beef with portobello mushrooms.
instructions: Preheat a vertical broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the unsalted beef stock and bhuna spice blend.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers, if using a traditional doner kebab setup.
Broil the beef for 10-12 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Meanwhile, slice the onion and garlic, and saute them in a pan until softened.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the doner kebab by slicing the cooked beef into thin strips and serving it in the pita bread with the sauteed onion and garlic, tomato, lettuce, and yogurt sauce.
